notes.title: Magfest Mayhem & Demo Revival!
notes.content:
Esteemed Gamers,

Our expedition to Magfest, a spectacle of electronic wonders, has borne peculiar fruits. Amidst a throng of gasps and guffaws, we, clad in our finest top hats, have exorcised the mischievous bugs that once lurked in our game demo. Your words, a cascade of Victorian wisdom, guided our hands in this delicate endeavor.

Behold the rebirth of our demo! Not with grandeur and fanfare, but with the cunning and precision of a clockmaker, we've banished the digital gremlins. A mere foretaste, dear players, of the grander alchemy to be wrought in the full game. We cordially invite you to witness this refined spectacle, now free of its erstwhile digital pests.

In anticipation of further adventures,
Hammered Crow Games, LLC

notes.title: Bug fix for graphics settings
notes.content:
Hi players!

I just pushed a new version of the demo with a small but super important change. The demo was accidentally defaulting to the 'low' graphics settings which was only really meant to run on extremely old systems. ːsteamfacepalmː

It should now default to high, and we took out 'low' which had too many problems and wasn't enough of a performance improvement to justify the game looking that terrible and causing problems with puzzles.

notes.title: New areas are coming together, plus another demo bug squashed.
notes.content:
Hey adventure game fans,

We've got something thrilling coming your way! Our team is hard at work crafting the next chapter in our Victorian seaside adventure — the ominous Downtown Area! Prepare to be chilled to the bone with:

    😈 Demons lurking around every corner!
    🔍 Mind-bending murder mysteries!
    🎭 And a lot more spooky surprises!

Demo Update: Load/Save Bug Squashed! 🦟💥

We've heard your feedback, and we apologize for the inconvenience some of you faced with the load/save feature. Great news — the bug has been stomped! Go ahead, continue your adventure without a hitch!

Come say hi to us in the Discord to discuss bugs, feedback, or whatever! [url=https://discord.gg/yp7RrFFs]https://discord.gg/yp7RrFFs[/url]

Stay tuned for more thrilling updates! Thank you for your incredible support.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Big performance improvement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're stoked to announce a new patch on Steam. Now, not only can you select the graphics level and resolution that fits your style, but we've also sorted out those pesky problems with menu resolutions.

The best part? We've overhauled the render pipeline, meaning smoother gameplay and overall better performance.

We owe a massive shoutout to popsUlfr, who's been instrumental in helping us debug the issues. Thank you!!!

We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we do. Try them out, and let us know your thoughts!

[url=https://i.imgur.com/2kBofG4.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/2kBofG4.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Testing Dark Tides on the Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wt5x6Av.jpg[/img]

Our game is making great strides on the Steam Deck. The tests have been successful, and we're closer than ever to providing a seamless gaming experience on this new platform.

The full version will offer a perfect fit with the Deck's screen resolution. But you don't have to wait! Our demo is already running beautifully on the Steam Deck.

Here's a quick rundown of the key controls:

    Touch-screen: Move around and select things.
    Touch-pad: Control your cursor.
    Left trigger: Examine inventory items.
    Right trigger: Click on whatever your cursor is over.

We can't wait for you all to experience our game on the Steam Deck. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Dark Tides Demo: Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey Friends,

Big news - our Dark Tides demo is live!

We're two devs who've poured three years into creating this offbeat horror-comedy. After positive feedback at TooManyGames, we're excited to share a bit of it with you.

The demo's got chills, giggles, and a dash of what makes Dark Tides special. We're both nervous and excited to hear your thoughts. Your feedback means a lot to us and will shape the full game.

Dive in, experience Dark Tides, and let us know what you think!

See you there,

Your Dark Tides Team
